description: The data and context an AI system receives: source and training data, retrieved context, agent memory and incoming prompts. Name from the OECD Framework for the Classification of AI Systems.
Properties of the model itself, independent of a single task: robustness, explainability and drift in its predictions. Name from the OECD framework.
What the system does and produces: the quality and safety of its outputs and the success of the actions it takes. Name from the OECD framework.

The organization and people around the system: human oversight, records of decisions, adoption, satisfaction and business results. NIST's name for this dimension; the OECD framework calls it Economic Context.
Effects on people, society and the environment, such as the fairness of outcomes and environmental impact. No metric in the catalog covers this area yet. Name from the OECD framework.
The running service: latency, availability, errors and cost. Added by this toolkit, because the OECD and NIST dimensions have no runtime area.
